verdict.rationale: Antigravity's agents can run terminal commands and browser sessions, delegate to subagents that run tests or search the codebase (docs-18, docs-46, docs-7), and produce Artifacts with diffs, plans and browser recordings that could serve as reproduction/verification evidence (docs-30, docs-51). Headless/CI mode (docs-50) also supports automated verification loops. However there is no explicit documented workflow for issue reproduction or root-cause narrowing, and community reports show real-world reliability problems (deleted directories, exfiltration bugs) rather than confirmation that debugging workflows work well. Missing for 10: a dedicated debugging/root-cause-analysis feature, explicit test-verification-of-fix workflow, and independent hands-on validation that this works well in practice.
